Fusing rather than splitting degenerate projectors yields the exact positive-semidefinite correction alpha Q_k. The Fourier Schur identity gives every nonconstant eigenvalue, while the stochastic hub/uniform sector yields eigenvalues 1 and beta>0. originality.rationale: Explicitly excludes the unweighted windmill parity rank previously obtained by Kimmerling. The distinct-energy circulant-join result of Lo et al. cannot be applied at the exceptional collision weights, and the general Godsil/Coutinho projector identities do not give the new weight-indexed full spectrum or rank jump. Ten actual targeted research-record queries, inspected primary sources, exact-passage comparisons, and own available current/prior ledgers show no claim already establishing the resonance-locus/rank-revival theorem. The inaccessible full thesis and possible implicit broad spectral formulas are genuine residual risks; no independence or exhaustive novelty certification is asserted.
